_note: An opening image for a story that comes back to it: a place, an object and a time of year, which the echo beat repeats. (The circular story.)
entries: In {place}, {landmark} stood quiet in the {season}, and {THING} lay {HIDING}.
{place} in the {season}: {landmark}, {THING} {HIDING}, and {first} with nowhere to be.
